title: Welcome messages per mode (guide vs teacher)
body:
AgentChatWindow has a single welcome message but the issue spec says guide mode and teacher mode should have different greetings:
- Guide mode: 'היי היי, אשמח לעזור לך להחליט מה לעשות היום'
- Teacher mode: 'היי היי, אני המורה הפרטי שלך, אשמח לעזור לך'

Location: src/ui/web/learning-agent/AgentChatWindow/index.tsx welcome message
rationale: The spec explicitly calls for mode-specific greetings, but implementing them requires passing the mode to the welcome message which is set in useState on mount (before mode detection). Needs a different approach - perhaps detecting mode once on mount and storing it in state.

title: gradeLevel in AgentChatWindow is hardcoded
body: AgentChatWindow uses a hardcoded gradeLevel='7'. The user's actual gradeLevel should come from their profile or the user object. The FloatingAgentButton has access to useCurrentUser() which could provide this.
rationale: While not a regression (it was already hardcoded before this change), the learning context is less personalized without the correct gradeLevel.
